verdict.rationale: DBOS lets developers trigger workflows in code: cron schedules that can be created, paused and resumed at runtime, messages and notifications sent to running workflows via DBOS.send/recv, and a community-reported Kafka consumer pipeline that ran exactly-once per message. However, this is programmatic wiring of triggers in application code, not user-definable rules. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger definition layer, documented first-party event-source triggers (webhooks, DB changes, Kafka) beyond cron, and a no-code or AI-native rule configuration surface.
